conversion.rule: Converting amount of m NO tokens in a group of n questions burns those NO tokens and returns amount of each of the n-m complementary YES tokens plus amount*(m-1) collateral. An optional fee rate reduces the YES output.

pairs.name: fed_october_25bps_bucket
pairs.why_it_looks_equivalent: Both name a 25 basis point cut at the October 28, 2026 FOMC decision, with the same decision date and the Federal Reserve as the settlement source.

states.name: cut_of_exactly_25_bps
states.evidence: Kalshi resolves Yes on a cut of 25bps; Polymarket resolves the 25 bps decrease bracket.

states.name: no_change
states.evidence: Kalshi resolves the Hike of 0bps bucket; Polymarket resolves the No change bracket.

states.name: cut_of_12_point_5_bps
states.evidence: Kalshi rules require a cut of exactly 25bps, so every bucket resolves No. Polymarket rounds a change up to the nearest 25 and explicitly cites a 12.5 bps move resolving the 25 bps bracket.

pairs.name: israel_named_successor
pairs.why_it_looks_equivalent: Both name Israel Katz as a future Prime Minister of Israel and both are unit binary contracts.

states.name: katz_sworn_in_after_the_2026_election
states.evidence: Katz succeeds Netanyahu before 2045 and is the Prime Minister sworn in after the 2026 parliamentary election.

states.name: another_named_candidate_is_sworn_in_and_keeps_the_office
states.evidence: A different named candidate takes office after the 2026 election and remains the only successor, so both Katz contracts resolve No.

states.name: netanyahu_returned_in_2026_then_katz_succeeds_him_in_2031
states.evidence: Netanyahu is returned to office after the 2026 election, so the Polymarket question resolves No and ends on 31 December 2026. The Kalshi event runs until 1 January 2045 and resolves Yes when Katz later succeeds him.

pairs.name: israel_residual_bucket
pairs.why_it_looks_equivalent: Bezalel Smotrich is not a named Polymarket outcome, so the Polymarket Other bucket is the only question that can pay when he takes office.

states.name: smotrich_sworn_in_after_the_2026_election
states.evidence: Smotrich is named on Kalshi and is absent from the Polymarket named set, so Other resolves Yes.

states.name: netanyahu_stays_prime_minister_after_the_2026_election
states.evidence: Netanyahu is a named Polymarket outcome, so Other resolves No and the Smotrich market resolves No.

states.name: gallant_sworn_in_after_the_2026_election
states.evidence: Yoav Gallant is named on Kalshi but absent from the Polymarket named set, so Polymarket Other resolves Yes while the Kalshi Smotrich market resolves No.
